name: Peatland Restoration Sector Capacity Grant

funder.name: Defra (Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs)

summary: Annual grants for organisations already doing peatland restoration in England, to build sector capacity through specialist machinery, apprenticeships, training courses and equipment. Runs 2026 to 2030, with a summer application window each year.

calls.label: Annual summer application window
calls.recurring: Opens each summer; the first window was scheduled for June and July.

status.quote: The scheme will open for applications in the week commencing 8 June this year and remain open throughout June and July

recurring.quote: The application window is then scheduled to open again each summer.

geography.quote: to help grow the workforce and infrastructure needed to restore England's peatlands at pace

access.quote: The scheme is open to any organisation involved in peatland restoration.

window.quote: The application window is then scheduled to open again each summer.

amount.quote: Grant awards are available up to a maximum of £20,000 per annum, with both single-year and multi-year awards available.
